findings: Rejected. The decoder is a real Font.decode port plus a hand-typed family and PostScript table, and it is not a fixture lookup. It is not accept-ready: modelled_family maps the user string monospace to Menlo, and creole monospace and monospaced are forced onto the surrounding face. The JDK probe (stdout dd457c41, OpenJDK 21.0.5) shows Font.decode(monospace) is Dialog at 51.966796875 and Font.decode(Monospaced) is Monospaced at 67.4296875.

Batch CN, compare_svg_strict on the relayed Java SVG (results 7d1c1dad, 46/46 exit 0, empty stderr): base 8/46, tip 29/46, 21 gains, 0 lost whole-SVG matches. Batch CG: base 1/6 (g3_times_dialog), tip 6/6, 0 losses. The eight c9a_ns_menlo controls go from miss to strict match.

chk_creole_menlo_class is a packet-caused metric loss inside an already-failing diagram. Java measures <font:monospace>Quill vx as family monospace, textLength 51.9668 (Dialog) and <font:monospaced> / <font:Monospaced> as family monospace, textLength 67.4297. Base matched the monospace width (51.9668) because the surrounding face was still Lucida Grande. Tip measures that span as Menlo 67.4297. The surrounding-face exception matches an activity golden only when the surrounding face is already Dialog.

chk_elem_seqfont_helvetica_bold: sequenceFontName is not a FontParam, so Java ignores it and keeps Times (viewBox 0 0 112 123, Alice textLength 32.7236, message 16.4531). Base stamped family Helvetica-Bold but kept those Times widths. Tip resolves Helvetica-Bold, drops the Bold token, and measures Helvetica regular (viewBox 0 0 109 115, Alice 30.3447, message 14.4473).

chk_skin_monospace_word is base-equal and tip-equal and both disagree with Java: viewBox 0 0 99 84 and textLength 67.4297 against Java 0 0 89 84 and 51.9668. The new table re-encodes the alias. Helvetica-Light and Helvetica-LightOblique stay registered faces in the probe (18.648000717163086) and in census.tsv, and both trees fall through to Lucida Grande 17.7188. Quoted defaultFontName " Menlo " measures Menlo at the tip, but the SVG family is 'Menlo' rather than ' Menlo '.
